process.progress_definition: terminal product evidence or closed acceptance criterion

engineering_standard.mutable_alias_policy: discovery_only; after target selection execution is governed by exact signed identity/hash and the alias transition itself must be rehearsed if the consumer is pinned to it
engineering_standard.cloud_change_policy: capture exact current deployment/version first; create a non-production version/preview when provider supports it; verify there; deploy exact verified version; rollback by exact prior version identity
engineering_standard.rollback_policy: pre-registered last-known-good artifact/version; never rebuild rollback during an incident
engineering_standard.build_policy: complete source/dependency/vendor/generated-input closure before paid or remote build
engineering_standard.worker_directive_policy: derive from validated execution capsule; do not improvise the run plan after mutation begins
engineering_standard.progress_policy: count only terminal product evidence or a closed acceptance criterion

estimation.allowed_basis: measured stage durations from a validated path plus explicitly identified irreducible unknowns

hidden-build-inputs.symptom: remote build reveals missing dependency/vendor/generated input in successive paid attempts
hidden-build-inputs.prevention: complete local dependency/vendor/generated-input closure and fail closed before paid build

timeout-budget-inversion.symptom: outer process timeout is shorter than worst-case nested calls
timeout-budget-inversion.prevention: machine validator requires outer >= inner_calls * inner_timeout + margin

restore-evidence-loss.symptom: host comparison raises before actual post-restore state is preserved
restore-evidence-loss.prevention: persist raw observed state/evidence before evaluating equality or raising

credential-transport-surprise.symptom: live execution stops on SSH/browser/password/host-key interaction
credential-transport-surprise.prevention: prove noninteractive worker transport and exact identity before live stage; user credential entry cannot be a hidden runtime dependency

mutable-pointer-role-mismatch.symptom: valid signed recovery exists but consumer reads a different mutable pointer/role
mutable-pointer-role-mismatch.prevention: test the actual consumer URL/role contract and rehearse every required pointer transition before diagnostic install

cloud-asset-reconstruction-risk.symptom: recovery publication would require rebuilding an incompletely captured live asset set
cloud-asset-reconstruction-risk.prevention: capture exact deployable version/artifact or provider-native rollback identity before mutation; never reconstruct production during incident response

stale-operational-state.symptom: machine-readable control state still describes a closed blocker and drives wrong next action
stale-operational-state.prevention: update operational state immediately when a blocker is closed or superseded; platform doctor treats stale cross-contract identity as failure

manual-prompt-improvisation.symptom: worker prompt changes execution mechanics after mutation begins
manual-prompt-improvisation.prevention: generate worker directive from validated capsule; no silent substitutions after execution starts
